what_this_is: Trillion's own screens (Home, Files, Decisions, Spaces and the rest) as Workshop tools a person opens rather than an AI runs: each row's screen mounts the Trillion screen it names (screen.entry, src/workspace/main.tsx), or is its own code in a tool folder (screen.kind module, screen.module { package, entry }: built into a bundle the page imports when the screen opens, scripts/screen-modules.mjs) and screen.surface says where it sits and how it opens (its id, sidebar list, order, addresses, glance and actions; the fields src/workspace/surfaces.json describes). src/workspace/screens.mjs reads these rows as the workspace's screens, so the sidebar, Home and the screen arrangement list exactly these. A screen-only row has no invoke, so it is never offered to run (src/workshop.mjs offers only tools with an invoke and a placement). Any tool whose screen names `replaces: "<screen id>"` (a saved tool, or a row in an open tool folder) takes that screen's id and place for the account that has it (src/work-workshop.mjs toolSurfaces, src/workspace/main.tsx). A new screen is a row here. A screen that opens on one file carries screen.takes_file { takes (a kind of file-takes.json), label, icon, input }: every file card (src/workspace/file-card.ts) of a file that kind takes offers it, opening the screen with input, whose { from: "file", field } values are that file's identity, name, type, folder or bytes address.
